meta.scope: France hors Mayotte; communes matched on exact INSEE code
meta.distance_method: Straight-line distance from the commune town hall; blank distance is counted as over 30 km.
limitations: A distance does not confirm that a doctor accepts new patients.
Distance is not a road journey or a travel-time estimate.
Hospital outpatient specialist consultations are not represented.
Fee categories are not a measure of a person's actual out-of-pocket cost.
